data.gender_notes: Mustajab is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who responds to the supplications or calls of Allah. Derived from the Arabic root 's-t-j', meaning 'to respond, to return'. The name Mustajab carries the meaning “Responsive, Answering” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mustajab usually hope their child will grow to embody responsive, answering and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes a deep connection with Allah and a life dedicated to answering His calls.
data.etymology: Mustajab belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Responsive, Answering.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mustajab total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
